scope: Kubernetes v1.36.1 ValidatingAdmissionPolicy CREATE and UPDATE checks for synthetic Deployments in a case-owned namespace. The admission decision compares classification, target, policy version and artifact digest claims with a separate administrator-supplied ConfigMap for one synthetic release. The digest is computed from an inert fixture. Actual production model registry integrity, signers, promotion pipelines and organization-wide policy enrollment require production evidence.
